segments.ja330:1.1: Sīlaṃ kireva kalyāṇaṃ, sīlaṃ loke anuttaraṃ;
segments.ja330:1.3: Passa ghoraviso nāgo, sīlavāti na haññati.
segments.ja330:2.3: Saṅgamma kulalā loke, na hiṃsanti akiñcanaṃ.
segments.ja330:3.1: Sukhaṃ nirāsā supati, āsā phalavatī sukhā;
segments.ja330:3.3: Āsaṃ nirāsaṃ katvāna, sukhaṃ supati piṅgalā.
segments.ja330:4.1: Na samādhiparo atthi, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca;
segments.ja330:4.3: Na paraṃ nāpi attānaṃ, vihiṃsati samāhitoti.
segments.ja330:7.3: Atha kāyasakepuka bhotīvaro, atha rādhasusīlavarena dasāti.
